mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eattea_document (title, file_name, file_type, file_path, content, department, doc_category, publish_date, tags, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{fileName}, #{fileType}, #{filePath}, #{content}, #{department}, #{docCategory}, #{publishDate}, #{tags}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, file_name, file_type, department, doc_category, publish_date, tags, create_time, MATCH(content) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE) AS relevance FROM eattea_document WHERE MATCH(content) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE) ORDER BY relevance DESC LIMIT 50
mapper.update: UPDATE eattea_document SET title = #{title}, department = #{department}, doc_category = #{docCategory}, publish_date = #{publishDate}, tags = #{tags}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
